limitations.note: The counter change fixes the premature wrap, but removing the `ready_b` guard also changes `data_out` when the first input of a group is accepted while `ready_b` is low.
The scoreboard starts each group from zero regardless of `ready_b`, so the test passes the extra behavior change rather than detecting the mismatch with the original accumulation logic.
